title: 第11章 痛杀张龙赵虎第12章 简化蛇形刁手
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
张龙高瘦，赵虎壮实，两人不断闲聊，并不把赵寒放在眼里，双眼却时不时如鹰眼般扫视四周。
显然，他俩是冲着赵寒手里的精力丸来的，也顺带打压赵寒。
打压新人，在哪里都不奇怪，算是各行各业的潜规则了。
“竟然是王亮那家伙透露的。”赵寒双眼一凝。
王亮就是那几名擅长打猎的帮众，闲谈时知道赵寒经常来东边练武。
“原来精力丸能卖一两银子！”
这可不便宜啊。
一两银子在这个世界的购买力，堪比两千块。
相当于一文钱，有着两块钱的购买力。
一文钱就能买一个两拳头大的死面馒头。
客栈小二的月钱才一百文呢，干苦力的也就三百文钱，一两银子可不是少数。
这两人会起贪念，也正常。
“他俩为什么知道我手里有精力丸，莫非是刘刚告诉他俩的。”
除了刘刚之外，无人知晓自己手里有精力丸，也只能是刘刚说的。
显然是刘刚告诉两人，这两人也必然是刘刚的心腹肱股。
赵寒神色一凝，刚才还说回报刘刚的，没想到这会就给推翻了；果然，这个世界任何人都不能轻易信任。
两人缓缓离开赵寒的视线，径直往前。
“既然你俩要找死，那我就成全你们。”赵寒轻蔑一笑，想到了个好办法。
跳下了树，压低身形摸了上去，紧跟两人身后。
顺势捡起地上一块尖锐的石头，没有飞斧，石头也行。

“好机会！”
来到一个缓坡上，赵寒居高临下看到两人背对着自己，正在聊天。
“着！”
“嗖！”
石头径直砸了上去，两人听到了破风声，立刻转头看来，刚好尖锐的石头正中右边赵虎的面门。
“啊！”
尖锐部位直接将赵虎的一只眼球戳瞎，眼眶和眼睛都迅速流血肿了起来，惨不忍睹。
一屁股坐在地上捂着眼睛，哀嚎不断。
“姓赵的是你！你竟敢偷袭同门，按照帮规这是要砍断手指的。”
张龙脸色一变，恶狠狠道，拿出毒蛇帮的帮规来压赵寒。
“我可不是你的同门，我明明是黑狼帮帮众。”赵寒冷笑一声，拔出腰间砍刀，径直冲了上去。
近战有兵器用兵器，没兵器就用拳法。
“黑狼帮帮众？什么意思？莫非……你是奸细！”
“你废话真多，去死！”
一刀直劈面门，张龙脸色剧变，这赵寒是来真的，想要把他俩砍死在这。
content_en:
Zhang Long was tall and thin, while Zhao Hu was strong. The two chatted constantly and did not take Zhao Han seriously, but their eyes scanned the surroundings like an eagle's eye from time to time.
Obviously, they came for the energy pill in Zhao Han's hand, and they also suppressed Zhao Han.
Suppressing newcomers is not surprising anywhere. It is an unspoken rule in all walks of life.
"It was actually Wang Liang who revealed it." Zhao Han's eyes narrowed.
Wang Liang was one of the gang members who was good at hunting. During their chat, he learned that Zhao Han often came to the east to practice martial arts.
"It turns out that energy pills can be sold for one tael of silver!"
This is not cheap.
The purchasing power of one tael of silver in this world is comparable to two thousand dollars.
It is equivalent to one penny and has the purchasing power of two dollars.
One penny can buy a two-fist-sized steamed bun with dead noodles.
The monthly salary of a waiter in an inn is only 100 cash, and the monthly salary of a coolie is only 300 cash. One tael of silver is not a rare thing.
It's normal for these two people to be greedy.
"Why do they know I have energy pills in my hand? Could it be that Liu Gang told them."
Except for Liu Gang, no one knew that he had energy pills in his hand, and it could only be said by Liu Gang.
Obviously Liu Gang told the two of them that these two people must be Liu Gang's confidants.
Zhao Han's expression condensed. He just said that he would repay Liu Gang, but he didn't expect that he would overturn it now. As expected, no one in this world can be trusted easily.
The two slowly left Zhao Han's sight and went straight forward.
"Since you two are looking for death, then I will help you." Zhao Han smiled contemptuously and thought of a good idea.
He jumped down from the tree, lowered his body and touched it, following closely behind the two of them.
Pick up a sharp stone on the ground. If you don't have a throwing ax, a stone will do.
"Good opportunity!"
Arriving on a gentle slope, Zhao Han looked down and saw two people chatting with their backs to him.
"Go!"
"Whoosh!"
The stone hit him straight up. When they heard the sound of breaking wind, they immediately turned around and saw that the sharp stone hit Zhao Hu's face on the right.
"Ah!"
The sharp part directly poked out one of Zhao Hu's eyeballs, and the eye socket and eyes quickly bleeded and swollen, which was terrible to see.
He sat down on the ground, covering his eyes, and kept wailing.
"You're the one with the surname Zhao! How dare you sneak up on a fellow sect member. According to gang rules, your fingers will be cut off."
Zhang Long's expression changed and he said fiercely, taking out the Viper Gang's rules to suppress Zhao Han.
"I'm not your fellow disciple, I'm obviously a member of the Black Wolf Gang." Zhao Hanhan laughed, pulled out the machete from his waist, and rushed forward.
In close combat, use weapons if you have weapons, and use boxing if you don't have weapons.
"Black Wolf Gang Gangzhong? What do you mean? Could it be...you are a spy!"
"You talk so much nonsense, go to hell!"
The knife struck directly at the door, and Zhang Long's expression changed drastically. Zhao Han was serious and wanted to chop the two of them to death here.
